page_title: MCI 4-1 AST | Manchester City v Aston Villa 03/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Calum Chambers (Aston Villa) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.

90+3' Sergio Gomez (Manchester City) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was! The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.

90+2' Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) finds some space to control the ball from the corner and shoots, but his attempt goes way wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Manchester City.
90+1' The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

90' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to turn the rebound in from close range. Nevertheless, the goalkeeper pulls off a stunning save and stops the ball from hitting the net. Great goalkeeping.
88' Ezri Konsa (Aston Villa) sends a cross into the box, but Stefan Ortega comes off his line to gather the ball.
85' Darren England has a clear sight and sees a foul from Manuel Akanji (Manchester City).
80' Pep Guardiola prepares a substitution. Jeremy Doku is replaced by Sergio Gomez (Manchester City).
80' Substitution. Oscar Bobb (Manchester City) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Phil Foden walks off.

80' Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) shows brilliant individual skill to find some space and tries his luck from long range, but the shot flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
78' PENALTY APPEAL by Aston Villa, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
77' Here is a change. Nicolo Zaniolo is going off and Unai Emery gives the last tactical orders to Omari Kellyman (Aston Villa).
75' Substitution. Bernardo Silva makes way for Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City).
75' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Matheus Nunes (Manchester City) comes onto the pitch for Rodri.
71' Unai Emery has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alex Moreno (Aston Villa) replacing Jhon Duran.

69' 4 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Phil Foden (Manchester City) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot into the top right corner. His attempt was beyond the reach of Robin Olsen, so the score changes to 4:1.
68' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Rodri (Manchester City) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
64' It is time for a substitution. Calum Chambers (Aston Villa) is on for Douglas Luiz.
63' Unai Emery decides to make a substitution. Moussa Diaby will be replaced by Leon Bailey (Aston Villa).
63' The referee signals a substitution. Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) is brought on as a substitute for Tim Iroegbunam.

62' 3 - 1 Phil Foden (Manchester City) latches on to a precise pass inside the penalty box and produces a sweet strike that beats the goalkeeper as it goes into the bottom right corner, bouncing off the post.
61' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) sends a long ball in, but Stefan Ortega comfortably gathers the ball.
59' Phil Foden (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
56' Clement Lenglet (Aston Villa) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the middle of the goal is comfortably saved by the goalkeeper.
56' The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.

55' A neat pass is well received by Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the top left corner. The goalkeeper makes a decent save to block his shot. The linesman makes the right call and Aston Villa will have a corner.
54' The current number of shots on goal is 8:1.

54' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) receives a low pass just outside the box and drills a fine strike towards the middle of the goal. Robin Olsen pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
53' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Darren England blows for a foul.
52' One of the Manchester City players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
50' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Manchester City.
49' Great chance! Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) collects a great pass inside the box, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
48' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Robin Olsen is alert and denies him.
46' A lofted cross from Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+6' Darren England has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+5' A corner kick by Manchester City is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Olsen (Aston Villa).

45+5' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) attempts to convert a lofted cross as he jumps high and heads the ball towards the roof of the net. Robin Olsen shows his brilliant reflexes and pulls off a glorious save to stop the ball from hitting the net. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Manchester City will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+4' A pass lands at the feet of Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
45+3' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Manchester City was in an offside position.
45+1' 2 - 1 Phil Foden (Manchester City) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up inside the left post.
45+1' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.

45' Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. A free kick has been awarded to Manchester City.
44' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Darren England saw the whole situation.
41' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
39' Julian Alvarez (Manchester City) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball goes out of play and Aston Villa will have a goal kick.
38' Manchester City win a free kick.
38' Darren England shows a yellow card to Douglas Luiz (Aston Villa) for his blatant foul.

37' Robin Olsen was forced into action to thwart Julian Alvarez (Manchester City). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
35' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) attempts a long crossfield pass, but the defence does well to intercept the ball.
32' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) has too much to say to the referee and receives a yellow card.
31' Darren England blows his whistle. Jack Grealish (Manchester City) commits a foul after dangerous play.
31' Moussa Diaby (Aston Villa) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
26' An attempted cross from Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) is cleared.

24' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) has a first-time shot at goal. It's a good effort from the edge of the box, but flies just a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
23' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Robin Olsen intercepts the ball.
22' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Aston Villa players have a reason to celebrate!
21' The Aston Villa players halt their celebrations as referee Darren England makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
20' 1 - 1 Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems fires the ball into the back of the net.
18' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
18' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) pulls the shirt of his opponent and the referee stops play for a foul.
17' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
16' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Aston Villa.
15' Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
12' Darren England sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
12' Wait! Referee Darren England has indicated he is going to review the Manchester City goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
11' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Jeremy Doku slips the ball through to Rodri (Manchester City), and he darts into the box to unleash a magnificent shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:0.

10' Rodri (Manchester City) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Robin Olsen pulls off an easy save.
9' Manchester City players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
8' Manchester City couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Robin Olsen (Aston Villa) leaped high and intercepted the cross.

7' Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) brings his opponent down. Darren England has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Manchester City win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
6' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
3' Jack Grealish (Manchester City) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
1' The corner is swung in but Aston Villa can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
1' Nicolo Zaniolo (Aston Villa) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
1' The match has just started.
Aston Villa will kick the game off.
Darren England will supervise the game today.
